question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

21 ÷ 3 - 35 + 7 × 28 = 224
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a4eac2de7cdd05f87b05c022300c335b8ee508c7edd24cfa93be7cc83e8716d.png] Given equation is :

21 ÷ 3 - 35 + 7 × 28 = 224

**(I) 21 ÷ 3 - 35 + 7 × 28 = 224**

**Interchanging ( × ) and ( - ) and applying BODMAS rule,**

21 ÷ 3 × 35 + 7 - 28 = 224

7 × 35 + 7 - 28 = 224
